'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Pistone DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Don't tell me what I can't do!
* '''Username:''' Pistone84
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
